_note: Score Mandate session-exit arm (written September 26, 2026 for Chunk 3; run by the next session's exit, SCORE_MANDATE_PLAN.md §5): the ten-minute test on a fresh boot. Every phrasing is sourced: the Creative AAR's hand-played turn 1 (help / what can I do / who am I fighting and why / Talleyrand, assess our situation / who are we at war with / status / economy), its rows AAR-17 (is Vienna safe / what does Kutuzov have with him / how long until the armistice with Russia expires) and AAR-18 (what can I build), its turn-5 what-if (what are Ney's odds against Vienna), the first-contact memo's families (hello / what now / how do I win / undo / how many men do I have / is Mack strong), the boot help's own examples (Ney, attack Mack / is Paris safe / what happened last turn), and CRT-7's who are my allies / who is winning / how is the war effort. Read each reply against dc297b50 (the tree before SR-3a) on the same seed.
